meta.dataset: Hurricane Harvey event reports, Updates #1 to #22 (26 August to 7 September 2017), PETROLEUM REFINERIES sections
meta.evidence: Counts and capacities: HISTORICAL (as printed). Refinery membership: RECONSTRUCTED by arithmetic, not stated by DOE.
method: DOE printed, for each report, how many refineries were shut (or shutting down) and their combined capacity, 'according to public reports'. It did not name them.

For each report, every set of that many PADD 3 refineries in the EIA Refinery Capacity Report as of 1 January 2017 (55 refineries with a crude distillation capacity) was tested; a set fits when its capacities add up exactly to DOE's figure.
That arithmetic alone does not identify the refineries: for most reports hundreds of different sets fit (setsFittingTheTotalAlone).

Updates #1 to #9 also print the number of refineries in each of three named areas. Each Texas refinery is assigned to the area of its nearest reference city (Corpus Christi; Houston or Galveston; Beaumont or Port Arthur) if within 125 km; the same assignment results for any radius from 108 to 166 km. A report is 'resolved' only when exactly one set fits both the total and the regional counts.
Updates #10 to #22 print no regional counts. Their membership is left unknown.

assumptions: DOE's combined capacities were built from the EIA capacities as of 1 January 2017 (barrels per calendar day). The exact agreement of the resolved reports with that table supports this; DOE does not state it.

DOE's area names mean what the nearest-city rule says they mean. DOE does not define them. The rule puts exactly six refineries in the Corpus Christi area, matching DOE's 'all six', and their capacities add up to DOE's 924,720 b/d.
caveats: 'Shut down or in the process of shutting down, according to public reports' covers precautionary shutdowns, flooding, power loss, port closures and crude supply problems. DOE does not attribute causes to named refineries.
Capacities are nameplate crude distillation capacity, not lost output.
Reports the method cannot resolve say nothing here about which refineries were shut at that time.
